title: knn-membership-reliability: code, preregistrations and raw results for the study of input membership and decision reliability in compressed plant disease diagnosis
description: Code (confidence signals, metrics, two-loop rejection gate), preregistrations (stages S2-S4), rule-based label alignment and raw result files of all runs for the study of what the built-in confidence of a compressed nearest-neighbour plant disease diagnosis pipeline measures. Feature caches are not included: they are derived from datasets whose licences forbid redistribution of derivatives.
